+import asyncio
+import os
+from typing import AsyncIterator, Optional
+
+import httpx
+
+
+OPENAI_AUDIO_STREAM_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/audio/speech"
+
+
+async def _iter_source_chunks(source: AsyncIterator[bytes], max_chunk_size: int) -> AsyncIterator[bytes]:
+    buffer = bytearray()
+    async for part in source:
+        if not part:
+            continue
+        buffer.extend(part)
+        while len(buffer) >= max_chunk_size:
+            yield bytes(buffer[:max_chunk_size])
+            del buffer[:max_chunk_size]
+    if buffer:
+        yield bytes(buffer)
+
+
+async def stream_audio_chunks(source: AsyncIterator[bytes], chunk_size: int = 4096) -> AsyncIterator[bytes]:
+    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=None) as client:
+        headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ.get('OPENAI_API_KEY', '')}"}
+        async with client.stream("POST", OPENAI_AUDIO_STREAM_URL, headers=headers) as response:
+            response.raise_for_status()
+            async for upstream_chunk in _iter_source_chunks(source, chunk_size):
+                if upstream_chunk:
+                    yield upstream_chunk
+            async for chunk in response.aiter_bytes():
+                if chunk:
+                    yield chunk
+
+
+async def stream_from_async_source(source: AsyncIterator[bytes], chunk_size: int = 4096) -> list[bytes]:
+    chunks = []
+    async for chunk in stream_audio_chunks(source, chunk_size=chunk_size):
+        chunks.append(chunk)
+    return chunks
+
+
+async def _empty_source() -> AsyncIterator[bytes]:
+    if False:
+        yield b""
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    async def _run() -> None:
+        await stream_from_async_source(_empty_source())
+
+    asyncio.run(_run())
*** End Patch

+import asyncio
+import json
+import os
+from typing import AsyncIterator, Optional
+
+import websockets
+
+
+DEEPGRAM_API_KEY_ENV = "DEEPGRAM_API_KEY"
+DEEPGRAM_MODEL = "nova-2"
+DEEPGRAM_URL = (
+    "wss://api.deepgram.com/v1/listen"
+    "?model={model}&interim_results=true&smart_format=true&punctuate=true"
+).format(model=DEEPGRAM_MODEL)
+
+
+async def stream_microphone(sample_rate: int = 16000, chunk_size: int = 3200) -> AsyncIterator[str]:
+    api_key = os.environ.get(DEEPGRAM_API_KEY_ENV)
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"{DEEPGRAM_API_KEY_ENV} is required")
+
+    import pyaudio
+
+    pa = pyaudio.PyAudio()
+    stream = pa.open(
+        format=pyaudio.paInt16,
+        channels=1,
+        rate=sample_rate,
+        input=True,
+        frames_per_buffer=chunk_size,
+    )
+
+    try:
+        async with websockets.connect(
+            DEEPGRAM_URL,
+            extra_headers={"Authorization": f"Token {api_key}"},
+            ping_interval=None,
+        ) as ws:
+
+            async def send_audio() -> None:
+                while True:
+                    data = await asyncio.to_thread(stream.read, chunk_size, False)
+                    await ws.send(data)
+
+            sender = asyncio.create_task(send_audio())
+            try:
+                async for message in ws:
+                    payload = json.loads(message)
+                    channel = payload.get("channel", {})
+                    alternatives = channel.get("alternatives", [])
+                    transcript = alternatives[0].get("transcript", "") if alternatives else ""
+                    if transcript and payload.get("is_final") is False:
+                        yield transcript
+            finally:
+                sender.cancel()
+                with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
+                    await sender
+    finally:
+        stream.stop_stream()
+        stream.close()
+        pa.terminate()
+
+
+async def main() -> None:
+    async for transcript in stream_microphone():
+        print(transcript, flush=True)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    import contextlib
+
+    asyncio.run(main())
*** End Patch
